title: Storm

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Steelbird Storm delivers breezy open-air freedom for scenic cruising and city exploration, pairing 180-degree panoramic sightlines with certified cranial protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1127g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~95 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ISI, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Round Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Steelbird Storm open face for city riders.

variants.title: Steelbird Storm Black
variants.description: The Steelbird Storm is a benchmark Open Face helmet crafted in Global Certified. Built around Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability, it is engineered specifically for Round Oval ergonomics. Optimized for urban commuters and retro cruisers, offering lightweight agility, wide peripheral vision, and step-through convenience. Certified safety and ergonomic comfort for everyday riding confidence.

product_details.description: Steelbird Storm open face for city riders.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Steelbird's Open Face lineup, the Storm brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Round Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ISI, ECE 22.05 track safety.
variants.story:
The Steelbird Storm represents Steelbird's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~95 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to a Round Oval head shape, the Steelbird Storm delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Steelbird Storm Black (gloss finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Steelbird Storm in Steelbird Storm Black. A stylish, low-profile open-face helmet pairing vintage roadster flair with certified multi-density cranial protection for warm-weather cruising.
variants.fitment_notes: Sculpted for Round Oval head shapes with low-profile ear pockets and open-cranial comfort lining. Minimal break-in required with instant pressure-free crown seating.

The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.

Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner engineered for open-air comfort and easy maintenance.
real_world_pros: Unrestricted 180-degree panoramic field of view for scanning traffic
Featherweight shell construction eliminates neck fatigue on casual rides
Plush, fully removable and washable moisture-wicking crown liner
real_world_cons: Open-face configuration lacks lower chin bar impact protection
Elevated cockpit wind noise at highway speeds requires earplugs
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Steelbird Storm is a benchmark Open Face helmet, engineered to deliver verified safety and all-day acoustic comfort.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Wide-vision jet shield with opti-clear optical clarity and optional peak sun deflection.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
